title_en: Wang Qian v. Lu Rongfang, Ningxia Jiangong Group Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., and Third Party Ningxia Hengchangsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — dispute over private lending
ruling_gist_en: A party who prevails in whole or in part at first instance but does not appeal, and during the second instance explicitly states that the first instance judgment is correct and should be upheld, then applies for retrial after the second instance judgment affirms the original decision, lacks retrial interest. Therefore, its retrial request should not be supported. Otherwise, it would indirectly encourage or condone parties lacking good faith to abuse the retrial procedure, resulting in misuse of litigation rights and waste of judicial resources.

full_text_en:
Wang Qian v. Lu Rongfang and Ningxia Construction Group Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., Third Party Ningxia Hengchangsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — dispute over private lending

Ruling Summary

Where a party that won or partially won at first instance does not appeal and clearly states during the second instance that the first-instance judgment is correct and should be affirmed, and then applies for retrial after the second-instance judgment affirms the original judgment, because such party lacks retrial interest, its retrial requests should not be supported. Otherwise, it would indirectly encourage or condone dishonest parties to abuse the retrial procedure, leading to an abuse of litigation rights and a waste of judicial resources.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2017) Supreme People's Court Civil Application No. 2483

Retrial Applicant (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Wang Qian, male, born September 27, 1985, Han ethnicity, residing at Room 1101, Building 6, Minsheng Garden, Jinfeng District, Yinchuan City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Lu Rongfang, female, born October 23, 1975, Han ethnicity, residing at Shanglu Community, Shanglu, Jiangbei Subdistrict, Dongyang City, Zhejiang Province.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance): Ningxia Construction Group Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 2, North of Central Avenue, No. 6 Road, Jinfeng District, Yinchuan City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.
Legal Representative: Bai Yuncheng, Chairman of the Board.
Agent ad litem: Liu Yanning, Ningxia Fude Law Firm.

Third Party at First Instance: Ningxia Hengchangsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 32, Jinbo Community, Huaiyuan East Road, Xixia District, Yinchuan City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.
Legal Representative: Xiao Tianjuan, Chairman of the Board.

Retrial Applicant Wang Qian, due to a dispute over private lending with Respondents Lu Rongfang, Ningxia Construction Group Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Construction Group), and Third Party at First Instance Ningxia Hengchangsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hengchangsheng Company), being dissatisfied with the Civil Judgment (2016) Ning Min Zhong No. 278 of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region High People's Court, applied to this Court for retrial. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel to review this case and has now concluded the review.

Wang Qian applied for retrial, alleging that this case meets the circumstances under Items 2 and 6 of Article 200 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC and should be retried. Requests: 1. Revoke Item 2 of the Civil Judgment (2015) Yin Min Chu No. 281 and revoke the Civil Judgment (2016) Ning Min Zhong No. 278, and retry this case according to law; 2. Amend the judgment to order Lu Rongfang to repay the principal of RMB 7.08 million and pay interest at an annual rate of 24% from September 6, 2015, until the date of actual repayment; 3. Order Construction Group to bear joint and several liability for the above principal and interest, and further order that Construction Group shall not dispose of a portion of the land use rights of the Xinyiyuan Project equivalent in value to the principal and interest until the full principal and interest are repaid; 4. The costs of first instance, second instance, and retrial shall be borne by Lu Rongfang and Construction Group. Facts and reasons: 1. The incomplete factual findings in the first and second instance judgments are the fundamental cause of the error. Before the loan occurred, Wang Qian did not know Lu Rongfang. Construction Group auctioned the land use rights involved on December 24, 2013, and Lu Rongfang was one of the buyers. Because Lu Rongfang could not afford the land transfer fee, Construction Group introduced Lu Rongfang to borrow money from Wang Qian. Construction Group and Lu Rongfang intentionally concealed from Wang Qian the fact that Construction Group and Hengchangsheng Company had already signed a "Joint Development of Real Estate Agreement" on March 20, 2014, regarding the land involved, and that all project proceeds belonged to Hengchangsheng Company, falsely claiming that the land was jointly developed by Construction Group and Lu Rongfang, causing Wang Qian to mistakenly believe that Lu Rongfang owned the land use rights, and thus lent money to Lu Rongfang based on Construction Group's supervision commitment. Although Construction Group signed the "Loan Agreement," it was completely unable to fulfill its supervision duties as agreed and could not assist Wang Qian in realizing the debt. The first and second instance judgments failed to identify Construction Group's significant fault. 2. The first and second instance courts erred in not ordering Construction Group to bear joint and several liability, which constitutes a mistake in fact finding and improper application of law. The "Loan Agreement" stipulates: "If this project cannot be jointly developed by Construction Group and Party B (Lu Rongfang), Party B must settle this debt before any disposal of the land use rights. Party B may dispose of the land use rights only after settling the debt. Party A shall not bear any responsibility for all obligations during the development process, such as construction costs and labor fees. After Party B has settled all debts to Party A, the land guarantee shall be automatically released." The precondition for this clause is that Lu Rongfang enjoys the land use rights, and only then can Construction Group supervise any disposal of the land by Lu Rongfang before the debt is cleared. The land use rights purchased by Lu Rongfang were her capital contribution as a shareholder to Hengchangsheng Company, and the land project was jointly developed by Construction Group and Hengchangsheng Company. The first instance court knew that Lu Rongfang did not enjoy the land use rights over the land involved but failed to identify Construction Group's liability, which is seriously inconsistent with the facts. Because Construction Group and Lu Rongfang used fraud and concealment in the loan process, causing Wang Qian to sign the "Loan Agreement" and lend money against his true intentions, the "Loan Agreement" should be revoked. Pursuant to Article 58 of the Contract Law of the PRC, Construction Group should bear joint and several liability. 3. The first and second instance judgments did not revoke the "Loan Agreement" but found it legally valid, yet they did not order Construction Group to perform its supervision duties as agreed in the agreement, resulting in an erroneous judgment.

Construction Group submitted its opinion stating: 1. There are no statutory grounds for retrial, and Wang Qian's retrial application cannot stand. The facts found by the first and second instance courts are consistent with the parties' agreements, and in accordance with the "Loan Agreement," the courts ordered Lu Rongfang to repay the principal and interest to Wang Qian. The results of the first and second instance judgments are not improper. Our company is not the lender, borrower, or guarantor, and the "Loan Agreement" explicitly states that our company only supervises and does not guarantee. Therefore, our company should not bear any liability in this case. Wang Qian's request for our company to bear joint repayment liability has no factual or legal basis and violates the principle of privity of contract. Wang Qian's claim that our company should not dispose of "the land use rights of the Xinyiyuan Project" has already been acquired by Lu Rongfang, Xiao Tianjuan, and Huang Jian through an auction. Our company is not the holder of those land use rights and has no rights over them or the authority to dispose of them. 2. At first instance, Wang Qian requested interest "until the date of payment determined by the effective judgment," but in the retrial request, he seeks interest "until the date of actual repayment." At first instance, Wang Qian requested an order that "Construction Group shall not dispose of a portion of the land use rights of the Xinyiyuan Project equivalent in value to the principal and interest until Lu Rongfang has fully repaid the principal and interest," but in the retrial request, he seeks an order that "Construction Group shall not dispose of a portion of the land use rights of the Xinyiyuan Project equivalent in value to the principal and interest until Construction Group has fully repaid the principal and interest." Wang Qian's retrial requests are inconsistent with his first-instance claims and should not fall within the scope of retrial review. 3. Wang Qian did not appeal in this case and is currently applying for enforcement of the effective judgment, indicating his acceptance of the first and second instance judgments. His retrial application increases the burden of litigation on the parties.

Upon review, the Collegial Panel of this Court finds that, based on the grounds for retrial raised by Wang Qian, this Court will examine whether Wang Qian's retrial application should be supported.

Article 164, Paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC provides: "If a party refuses to accept a judgment of first instance rendered by a local people's court, the party is entitled to appeal to the next higher people's court within 15 days from the date on which the judgment is served." Article 168 provides: "The people's court of second instance shall review the relevant facts and application of law with respect to the appeal claims." In accordance with the above legal provisions, the system of two-instance final adjudication is a fundamental system in China's civil litigation. If a party believes that a first-instance judgment is erroneous, it should appeal and exercise its litigation rights through the second-instance procedure. That is, a party should first choose the regular remedy procedures within the design of the civil litigation hierarchy, seeking relief for its rights through first-instance and second-instance civil procedures. The retrial procedure is a special remedy procedure granted to parties for possible significant errors in effective judgments. If a party still believes that an effective judgment is erroneous after exhausting regular remedy procedures, it may apply to the people's court for retrial. For a party that won or partially won at first instance but did not appeal, and where the second-instance judgment affirmed the original judgment and that party explicitly stated during the second instance that the first-instance judgment was correct and should be affirmed, because such party lacks retrial interest, its retrial requests should not be supported. Otherwise, it would indirectly encourage or condone dishonest parties to abuse the retrial procedure, transforming it from a special procedure into an ordinary procedure. This not only constitutes an abuse of litigation rights and a waste of judicial resources but also violates the basic principle of the two-instance final adjudication system.

In this case, the Yinchuan Intermediate People's Court of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region rendered the Civil Judgment (2015) Yin Min Chu No. 281, ordering Lu Rongfang to repay Wang Qian the principal of RMB 7.08 million and interest (calculated at an annual rate of 24% from September 6, 2015, until the date of payment determined in the judgment) and dismissing Wang Qian's other claims. Wang Qian did not appeal, which should be deemed as his acceptance of the first-instance judgment. Lu Rongfang, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed, claiming that Construction Group deceived Wang Qian into providing the loan to Lu Rongfang, that Wang Qian provided the loan only because of Construction Group's commitment, and that Construction Group should bear guaranty liability for the loan. Wang Qian, in response to Lu Rongfang's appeal claims and reasons, argued that the first-instance judgment had clear facts, sufficient evidence, and correct application of law and should be upheld. The Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region High People's Court in the second instance only reviewed Lu Rongfang's appeal claims and issued a corresponding judgment, which complies with Article 323 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, which provides: "The people's court of second instance shall conduct the trial around the appeal claims of the parties. Claims not raised by the parties shall not be tried, except where the first-instance judgment violates a legal prohibition or harms national interests, public interests, or the lawful rights and interests of others." Now, Wang Qian raises retrial requests, alleging that the first and second instance judgments omitted facts and harmed his lawful rights and interests, which is clearly inconsistent with his behavior of not appealing after the first-instance judgment and requesting affirmation of the first-instance judgment during the second instance proceedings. Moreover, the Civil Judgment (2016) Ning Min Zhong No. 278 of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region High People's Court dismissed Lu Rongfang's appeal and affirmed the original judgment, without changing the determination of Wang Qian's rights in the first-instance judgment. Therefore, Wang Qian's retrial application lacks retrial interest, and this Court will not support Wang Qian's retrial application.

In conclusion, in accordance with Article 204, Paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC and Article 395, Paragraph 2 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, this Court rules as follows:

Reject Wang Qian's retrial application.

Judge: Wang Guoxian
